details: Federal prosecutors and regulators, including the Commodity Futures Trading Commission (CFTC) and the Justice Department, are increasing their scrutiny of political prediction markets. This crackdown follows a surge in wagers tied to fast-moving political events and military operations, raising concerns about insider trading. Investigations include examining oil bets placed just minutes before a presidential announcement on Iran strikes, which triggered significant swings in energy and stock markets.
title: US Regulators Target Suspicious Prediction Market Bets

details: Bitcoin is experiencing downward pressure, with its price slipping towards $79,000. This decline is linked to higher Treasury yields and rising oil prices, which are contributing to a broader "risk-off" sentiment across traditional financial markets.
title: Bitcoin Dips as Higher Yields & Oil Prices Fuel Risk-Off Mood
